Address.description: The physical address for the device on the I2C bus.

Bus.description: The bus index to which the device is attached

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

StaticEndpointID.description: Assign the provided endpoint ID to the peripheral device and exclude the EID from the dynamic allocation pool. If StaticEndpointID is not defined then the device will be allocated an endpoint ID from the dynamic pool.

BridgePoolStartEID.description: Assigns the endpoint ID for the bridge pool to start with. If BridgePoolStartEID is set to 0, it will be disabled automatically.

BridgePoolEndEID.description: Assigns the endpoint ID for the bridge pool to end with.

PollingInterval.description: Health check interval in seconds. 0 to disable.

IgnoreEIDs.description: A comma separated list of endpoint IDs to be ignored by BusOwner.

RecoveryThreshold.description: Number of MCTP setup failures before attempting USB endpoint recovery. Allowed values are numeric strings from 0 to 10. A value of 0 disables recovery and is equivalent to omitting this property.

IgnoreMessageTypes.description: A comma separated list of MCTP message types in decimal format to be ignored by BusOwner.
